title: Exchange supply of ETH shrinks amid sideways price, more staking
summary: The validator entry queue for the Ethereum network is jam-packed, with 3.6 million tokens lined up to be staked with a forecasted 63-day wait.

title: Cere Network co-founder, board face $100M lawsuit over token sales
summary: Cere Network is facing a second lawsuit this month that accuses its co-founder and board of fraud in relation to a public token launch for the platform in 2021.

title: XRP millionaire wallets are ramping up in 'encouraging sign': Santiment
summary: The rise in XRP wallets holding more than 1 million tokens comes despite a weakening of broader crypto market sentiment, with a popular crypto indicator sitting in “fear” territory.

title: Gold nearly adds Bitcoin’s entire market cap in a single day
summary: Gold is now also outperforming Bitcoin over the last five years, having risen 173%, while Bitcoin is up only 164% over the same period.

title: Bitcoin rallies expected to be short-lived until liquidity returns: Data
summary: Bitcoin price breakouts fail to hold due to insufficient bid-side liquidity. Glassnode analysis identifies the key metrics that are likely to mark the next phase of BTC price expansion.

title: SEC gives guidance on issuer vs 3rd-party tokenized securities
summary: The US regulator has defined tokenized securities as either issuer-sponsored or third-party models, clarifying that the blockchain format doesn’t exempt assets from federal securities law.

title: Worldcoin spikes 40% as OpenAI reportedly plans biometric X rival
summary: A small team is developing the platform, according to sources, which may integrate ChatGPT for content creation while using biometrics for proof-of-personhood.

title: US senators quiz deputy AG over DOJ crypto unit shutdown
summary: The six US senators cited a 162% jump in illicit crypto activity in 2025 to argue that the DOJ should not have disbanded its cryptocurrency enforcement team.

title: Tokenized stocks ‘inevitable’ and may stop trading freezes: Robinhood CEO
summary: Robinhood CEO Vlad Tenev says while settling stock trades only takes one day, it is still “far too long,” a problem tokenized stocks can likely solve.

title: MegaETH mainnet to launch Feb. 9 after clocking 35K TPS in testing
summary: The 10.7 billion transactions seen during MegaETH’s stress test were more than the Ethereum blockchain has seen in its 10–year history.
